purpose: Numerical verification of a synthetic three-dimensional laminar duct and its passive constant-property heat equation; no experimental or aircraft validation claim
parameter_source: Explicit synthetic choices matching the existing aspect-2 rectangular Graetz model; dimensions and temperatures are not recovered device geometry or measurements
mesh: Gmsh 3D transfinite recombined hexahedra; all three directions resolved; four separate no-slip isothermal wall patches; no empty or symmetry patches
flow: simpleFoam, incompressible constant-property Newtonian laminar, steady SIMPLEC; inlet analytical rectangular Poiseuille profile normalized by face quadrature to stipulated flow, pressure zeroGradient; outlet kinematic pressure 0, velocity zeroGradient; all four walls U=0 and pressure zeroGradient; initial internal velocity and pressure zero
thermal: scalarTransportFoam, steadyState, scalar T has temperature dimensions, DT=k/(rho cp), solved frozen velocity/flux from converged flow, isotropic full 3D fluid diffusion, inlet T=300K, four walls T=310K, outlet zeroGradient; no solid, buoyancy, turbulence, radiation, viscous heating or temperature feedback
analytic_thermal_sentinel: Same mesh with uniform prescribed slip/plug velocity (verification only), theta=sin(pi*y/W) sin(pi*z/H) exp(r*x), r=-2*alpha*lambda/(U+sqrt(U^2+4*alpha^2*lambda)), lambda=(pi/W)^2+(pi/H)^2. Exact nonuniform Dirichlet values at both x ends, theta=0 on four sides; checks full 3D convection-diffusion equation
references: Frozen existing rectangular Graetz finite-volume code rerun at selected synthetic conditions without changing accepted evidence
Independent sine-Galerkin continuum Graetz reference; omits axial diffusion and is a model comparison, not exact same-PDE validation
interpretation: Graetz comparison exceeding 3 percent flags discrepancy; it is not a same-PDE pass/fail. Report all failures without threshold relaxation. Three levels support observed trends, not automatically an asymptotic error bound. Heat balance includes inlet axial conduction and actual numerical convective flux. Inlet-wall Dirichlet discontinuity produces logarithmically mesh-sensitive wall heat and inlet conductive heat separately. Do not claim total wall-heat convergence or physical realism; only signed discrete closure and convergent mixed outlet temperature are assessed. Endpoint pressure drop is reported separately from interior gradient.
publication: Local new worktree only; preserve frozen evidence; parent review before publication or application integration
pre_run_review_amendment: Before any solver execution, independent review identified inlet/wall corner heat-flux singularity and an insufficiently diffusion-sensitive high-Pe sentinel. Main corner retained with explicit exclusion; sentinel plug speed is now 0.05 m/s to make axial diffusion material.
discretization: Main thermal div(phi,T): Gauss upwind (bounded first order); analytic smooth sentinel: Gauss linear (centered). Gradient/interpolation linear; Laplacian corrected; steadyState.
definitions: Scalar exact relative L2 uses dimensionless theta with walls zero, not absolute 300 K temperature. Pressure-gradient least-squares fit uses x between 0.25L and 0.75L. Velocity L2 uses same interior range. Main heat uses converged SIMPLE phi unchanged. Main outlet zeroGradient.
